market.question: Will the highest temperature in Atlanta be between 74-75°F on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Atlanta April 30 high forecast: 73°F with 60% rain chance. The 74-75°F bucket is just one degree above the central forecast. With typical ±2-3°F forecast variance, the high landing in the 74-75°F bucket is plausible but the central forecast favors 72-73°F.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether rain dampens or breaks early enough for max temp to push into the 74-75 range
